evidence.title: Introducing Command: The Control Plane for AI Compliance
evidence.excerpt: ZeroDrift Command is live. It's a control center for enterprise developers to connect their AI communication systems and enforce compliance in real time, every email, chat, and reply checked against your policies and regulations before it goes out. Corey Hobbs (Founding Principal PM) walks through the product: create a workspace, pick a managed rulebook like SEC or FINRA or upload your own policy document, and connect your traffic. evidence.title: Introducing ZeroDrift: Move Fast and Stay Compliant
evidence.excerpt: Every message your firm sends is a regulatory event. ZeroDrift makes sure it's compliant before it goes out. Your team moves faster and communicates with more confidence than ever before. We are building the compliance infrastructure layer for enterprise communications. ZeroDrift enforces SEC, FINRA, and firm-specific policies in real-time across every channel where humans and AI write.
